EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice Under Section 7

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which are required for a public purposes:-

Description of the land to be acquired : Allotments of 09 Lots in Total Extent of about 0.2639 Hectare, depicted in Cadastral Plan No. 420204, Zonal No. 01 and Sheet No. 20 dated 31.10.2023 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the Village of Hawanawatta in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 715, Hawana in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Mallawapitiya in Kurunegala District in North-West Province.

01. Lot No. 01 Name of Land: Hawana Kumbura; Description : Paddy-field; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Perumbadage Sugathapala (Acquired under Section 38(A) of Land Acquisition Act, To Finalise the land acquisition); Extent: 0.0428 Hectare.

North by : Grama Niladhari Division of Palle Gattuwana; East by : Lot 108 in Sheet No. 01 and Lot 2 in same Plan; South by : Lots 338, 337 and 336 in Sheet No. 16; West by: Lot 336 in Sheet No. 16 and Grama Niladhari Division of Palle Gattuwana.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally or by agent duly authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat office of Mallawapitiya on the 22.07.2024 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 15.07.2024, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
W. P. C. N. Pathirana, Divisional Secretary, Mallawapitiya. At Mallawapitiya Divisional Secretariat, 13th May, 2024. EOG 06 - 0111
